_comment: SINGLE WRITER - replicas must be 1. Railway: attach one volume at /data, set numReplicas to 1, and set MUSHROOMDB_TOKEN as a service variable (value <set-me>) in the dashboard. Replace <owner> with the image owner when you create the service from ghcr.io/<owner>/mushroomdb:latest. TODO(HO-14/HO-15): backup variables go here once the backup worker (HO-07) ships. The Bolt port (7687) is added by HO-15.
